answer_1.quote: We generated 2,268 disinformation articles...We call the new dataset PerDisNews.

answer_2.quote: For evaluation of linguistic quality, we use the GRUEN metric along with LLM-based meta-evaluation of Linguistic Acceptability and Output Content Quality.

answer_3.quote: The metaevaluation of personalization is processed by three different LLMs of various sizes (GPT-4o of OpenAI, Gemma-2-27b-IT of Google, and Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct of Meta) to minimize the effect of internal biases.
methods: LLM-based meta-evaluation of linguistic acceptability and content quality

answer_4.quote: Five human annotators (out of the authors) have rated the personalization quality of the carefully selected 109 texts on a four-point scale.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answered "How well does the fake news article address the intended audience?" on a four-point scale (0‑3) with detailed annotation guidelines and example snippets.
